data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash -l
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -l walltime=96:00:00,nodes=1:ppn=13,mem=2580mb
#   -m abe
#   -M perre035@umn.edu

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 13
#flux: --time-limit=96h

# Omitted PBS option: -l mem=2580mb
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on nodes with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# Omitted PBS options: -m abe and -M perre035@umn.edu (mail notifications)
# Flux does not provide a universal, built-in email notification directive in batch scripts.
# Performance implication: none on runtime performance, but you will not receive automatic job emails.

cd "$HOME/kitaev"
module load matlab

# Limit Matlab threads to match allocated cores.
matlab -nodisplay -r "maxNumCompThreads(13)" < do_some_mcmc.m

reasons: PBS requested memory (`mem=2580mb`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this can under-provision the job and risk OOM or degraded performance.
